selection: E4e pre-registered 60-120 s mapping frames, 5 Hz with every fifth held out; do not reselect by outcome
comparison: E6-T-FUS: initial plus all actual updates versus identical frozen inputs and poses excluding the first update, separately for each eligible KF
settings: E1/E3: image size 512, uncalibrated, 1 s forced periodic KF, buffer 64, same weights and low VRAM configuration
eligibility: Choose static planar image ROI before examining 3D or replay outcomes; select fixed contiguous time window based on RGB visibility; record inability to verify correspondence and normal region; do not replace failures with zero.
metrics: E3 ROI first update valid correspondence and camera Z, initial-ray, local plane normal and final replay difference, same pixel support; image candidate support and world normal/tangent if independently verified overlap and stored poses exist
decision: Report failures and limits; no metric accuracy, global generalization, or improvement claims absent reference QA and independent physical overlap verification.
